_meta.description: Campaign ledger. Starts empty on purpose. A row is added only from an authorised first-party report - for example an Associates Central report the owner exports. No row is estimated, copied from a third party, or created from the site's own click counter. The site's click counter is a separate measurement and is never a reported order.
_meta.no_forecast_rule: No conversion score and no revenue forecast is published anywhere on this site. The Operating Agreement's Section 4 states Amazon makes no representation about the traffic or commission income an Associate can expect (source S-OA).
